Hi Alex —

Thanks again for carving out time today — really helpful conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned: 

What you told us: 
- Primary goal: trustable, low-latency document ingestion + semantic search for customer support KB (target 95th percentile latency < 150ms).
- Volume profile: ~200k monthly queries, bursty at EOD; documents contain PII and customer IDs.
- Timeline: pilot in Q2, production by end of Q3 if pilot succeeds.

Success criteria (your words): 
- <150ms p95 for typical queries
- Cost <$0.01/query (pilot target)
- SOC2 evidence and tenant isolation for controlled data access

Proposed next step: schedule a 60-90 minute technical deep dive / demo focused on: architecture we'd recommend, security/compliance controls (SOC2, VPC options), and a walkthrough of cost/throughput trade-offs.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Mar 2, 10:00-11:00 PT
- Wed Mar 3, 13:00-14:30 PT (can do 60 or 90m)
- Thu Mar 4, 09:00-10:00 PT

Could you confirm which of those works, and whether you want to loop in security and procurement on that call? I've attached a short product overview and our SOC2 summary for your security folks to review ahead of time.

Agenda suggestion (we can adjust):
1) 10m — goals & success criteria check
2) 25-40m — architecture & demo (runtime, caching, multitenancy)
3) 15-30m — security/compliance + procurement questions
4) 10m — next steps & mutual action items

Thanks — I'll hold the times until I hear back.
